title: Manager - Relay Operations
description:
This role requires a strong sense of ownership to lead relay operations in Brazil. The ideal candidate should be an experienced people leader with a bias for action and the ability to manage multiple shifts, establishing effective mechanisms to monitor operations 24/7.

This person will be responsible for building a reliable transportation network across Brazil, minimizing in-transit delays, and developing contingency plans to protect customer promises. The ability to motivate and coach a team of 30, maintain strong attention to detail, and drive continuous improvement is essential.

This role also demands strong communication skills to engage with senior leaders and prioritize business-critical requirements. A solid understanding of Brazil's transportation network, experience leading large teams, and a track record of process stabilization and stakeholder engagement are key to success in this position.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Build a reliable transportation network by developing mechanisms that ensure 24/7 network health monitoring, including vehicle tracking and tracing, capacity procurement, proactive delay detection, stakeholder mobilization, rescue plan development, and contingency planning for both anticipated and unanticipated network issues.
  • Own key metrics such as Linehaul to DEA and On-Time Performance. Also, be accountable for team fitness function metrics such as ticket SLA adherence.
  • Work closely with ATS Carrier Managers and the TOM team to drive carrier performance.
  • Use expertise and judgment to identify the right stakeholders, set appropriate goals, inform decision-making, and design long‑term solutions for transportation network operations.
  • Analyze and enhance network design in partnership with ATS to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure relevant business metrics are prepared, and actively participate in regular operations calls, business reviews (MBRs), and strategic planning documents for the ATS area.

About the Team

Relay Operations (RO) is the central command and control center for Transportation Execution across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle‑free and timely pickup and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), and from FCs to carrier hubs.

In the event of any exceptions, RO steps in to resolve issues and keeps all stakeholders informed throughout the process. In addition to this tactical problem‑solving, RO is also responsible for identifying trends in network exceptions and driving process improvements—either through automation or by proposing changes to streamline operations.

This strategic aspect involves continuous network monitoring and in‑depth data analysis. Overall, RO plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth operation of Amazon’s transportation network, directly impacting Amazon’s ability to deliver on customer promises.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
  • Experience owning program strategy, end‑to‑end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
  • Program/Project management experience
  • Advanced English knowledge

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience driving process improvements
  • Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de tecnologia, ameaças cibernéticas e evolução do mercado de segurança da informação ;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa, contribuindo para o crescimento técnico e estratégico do time comercial e dos parceiros Blockbit.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Redes de Computadores ou áreas correlatas;

  • Conhecimento técnico sólido em:
    • Soluções NGFW (Next-Generation Firewall);
    • SD-WAN (redes definidas por software e conectividade avançada);
    • EDR/XDR (detecção e resposta a endpoints e ameaças);

    • SOAR e CTI (desejável);
  • Experiência prática em projetos de conectividade e topologias de redes corporativas complexas;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar editais, especificações técnicas e requisitos de órgãos públicos ;
  • Habilidade em desenvolver documentação técnica detalhada , diagramas de arquitetura e comparativos técnicos;
  • Perfil proativo, disciplinado e orientado à produtividade , com excelente gestão de tempo e atenção a detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita , com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos para públicos executivos;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e compreensão de documentação e certificações internacionais;
  • Diferenciais:
    • Conhecimento em ferramentas de modelagem de linguagem e inteligência artificial (IA) aplicadas a automação de processos técnicos e comerciais;
    • Certificações técnicas relevantes;
    • Vivência em ambiente de fabricantes ou integradores de cibersegurança ;
    • Experiência prévia em projetos de governo e licitações públicas .
  • Alta capacidade de concentração, foco e entrega sob prazos curtos ;
  • Espírito colaborativo e interesse em trabalhar em um ambiente de inovação nacional em cibersegurança ;
  • Mentalidade analítica, curiosa e estratégica, com visão sistêmica sobre redes, segurança e infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de equilibrar profundidade técnica com comunicação clara e objetiva .

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com foco em inovação;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional contínuo em um dos setores mais estratégicos e em franca expansão.

title: Associate Director of Creative, UI/UX
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

We are hiring an Associate Director of Creative - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands-on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game-changing UI, conversion-oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on-time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

  • 3-6+ years of senior-level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.
  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About the Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity:

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains:

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring to Ledn:

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Haves:

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit:

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

title: AMXL Operations Specialist, AMXL
description:
Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It's essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance and quality. The role combines tactical analysis of metrics with operational management of the daily routine, resolving ground‑level deviations. It collaborates closely with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. The specialist is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, guaranteeing the best customer experience.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements.
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (pivot tables & charts, multiple‑criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.).
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent.
  • English language skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL.

title: Area Manager - Outbound & Delivery, Fulfillment Center
description:
Area Manager - Outbound & Delivery, Fulfillment Center

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Since our founding in 1994, we've grown from an online bookstore to a global technology leader in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence. We distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers across more than 100 countries. Our innovative spirit drives us to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible in logistics and delivery.

As we continue to expand our operations, we're seeking exceptional leaders who share our passion for innovation and customer obsession. At Amazon, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects, collaborate with world-class talent, and make a tangible impact on millions of customers' lives. We foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, and data-driven decision-making, empowering our employees to think big and bring their ideas to life.

As an Area Manager - Outbound and Delivery, you will play a crucial role in our complex and fast-paced logistics network. This dynamic position combines responsibilities across our Fulfillment Center (FC) and Delivery Station (DS) operations, requiring a versatile leader who can seamlessly manage both outbound processes and delivery preparations.

You'll be at the forefront of our customer-facing operations, ensuring that millions of packages are processed efficiently and prepared for timely delivery. Your focus will span four key areas: safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity. You'll be responsible for leading a diverse team of associates, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement in our outbound and delivery operations.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain comprehensive experience in Amazon's logistics ecosystem. Your decisions and innovations will directly impact Amazon's ability to meet and exceed customer expectations, playing a vital part in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.

As an Area Manager, you'll also be instrumental in shaping Amazon's future leaders. You'll mentor and develop your team, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation. This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and are passionate about delivering results that directly impact customer satisfaction.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and develop a team of warehouse associates and delivery personnel
  • Oversee performance, provide training, and address team member needs
  • Collaborate with other Area Managers to balance labor and ensure efficient operations
  • Review work forecasts and set productivity targets to meet overall building objectives
  • Oversee the outbound process from order fulfillment to last-mile delivery preparation
  • Monitor and improve KPIs such as On-Time Dispatch and First Day Delivery Success
  • Implement and support all safety programs and ensure OSHA compliance
  • Maintain a safe work environment for all associates in both FC and DS areas
  • Identify and lead process improvement initiatives using Lean tools
  • Analyze metrics to find root causes and drive operational enhancements
  • Develop practical solutions to complex problems without compromising quality
  • Liaise with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth outbound and delivery operations
  • Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to relevant departments
  • Embrace and lead change in Amazon's fast-paced environment
  • Support the implementation of new systems and processes in outbound and delivery operations

A day in the life

  • Work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required
  • Operate in both Fulfillment Center and Delivery Station settings
  • Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced atmosphere

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Portuguese
  • Employee and performance management experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Financial Systems)
description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Financial Systems)

Join to apply for the Quality Assurance Engineer (Financial Systems) role at Lumenalta .

At Lumenalta, we partner with forward‑thinking organizations to build technology solutions that scale, delight users, and accelerate business growth. Our team of global experts brings curiosity, commitment, and technical excellence to every project. We value transparency, autonomy, and impact, empowering every team member to do their best work.

The Role

We’re seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Engineer with a strong background in financial systems and market data applications. You will ensure the quality and reliability of mission‑critical applications across web, mobile, and API platforms. Working closely with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, you will identify issues, design comprehensive test plans, and safeguard the user experience.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, brings sharp problem‑solving skills, and has a proven track record in diagnosing and preventing issues in complex systems.

Responsibilities

  • Validate financial data functionality, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and system integrity.
  • Diagnose application issues by analyzing logs, reviewing server statistics, and observing system behavior.
  • Collaborate with developers and DevOps to triage and resolve defects.
  • Write clear, detailed bug reports with supporting artifacts to enable quick resolution.
  • Test backend integrations, ensuring data accuracy across PostgreSQL, Informix, MySQL, and related databases.
  • Ensure test coverage in continuous integration environments.
  • Maintain strong documentation of test cases, results, and defect trends.
  • Contribute to quality best practices across the SDLC and mentor others on QA standards.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA, with exposure across web, mobile, and API testing.
  • Deep understanding of data/event‑driven systems and excellent coding skills.
  • Hands‑on experience in financial systems and/or market data environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Xpath, CSS selectors, HTML, XML, and JSON.
  • Proficiency in SQL and 2–3 years of experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Informix, MySQL).
  • Ability to analyze system logs, identify bottlenecks, and proactively flag performance or stability issues.
  • Experience in a CI/CD environment and familiarity with version control tools (Git).
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, testing practices, and SDLC.
  • Strong Linux knowledge and comfort with command line debugging.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and explain complex issues clearly.

Job is 100% Remote. Please make sure you have a comfortable office set at your desired work location.

Job Title: Business Development Representative (Remote)
Location: 100% Remote (Global)
Schedule: Monday to Friday, U.S. business hours (flexible based on prospect market)
Salary: $2,000/month base + performance bonuses

About Our Client

ScaleSource is the world’s premier provider of top-quality offshore dedicated workers, helping companies significantly reduce labor costs while gaining access to exceptional global talent. Beyond business, ScaleSource is committed to elevating the livelihoods of skilled individuals worldwide, creating a meaningful and positive impact.

As part of its growth, ScaleSource is hiring high-performing Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to expand within the franchisor market and help businesses benefit from this proven model.

Position Summary

As a Business Development Representative , you will be responsible for executing multi-channel prospecting campaigns to generate and qualify new client opportunities. Assigned to a specific franchisor prospect list, your goal will be to exhaust that list through outbound communication (calls, emails, texts, LinkedIn) and deliver consistent qualified leads for ScaleSource.

This is a performance-driven role in a fast-moving environment with clear benchmarks and accountability. Successful BDRs will consistently hit and exceed monthly lead targets, directly impacting both company growth and their own earning potential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute outbound campaigns (calls, emails, texts, LinkedIn) to a targeted list of franchisor prospects.
  • Conduct discovery calls to assess fit and qualify client interest.
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach and pipeline activity in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with leadership to optimize outreach messaging and strategy.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly lead generation goals.

Performance Expectations

This is a high-accountability role with strict monthly targets:

  • Month 1: 2 qualified leads (non-negotiable – failure to meet this target will result in termination).
  • Month 2: 3 qualified leads.
  • Month 3 and beyond: 4 qualified leads per month.

Compensation & Bonus Structure

  • Base Salary: $2,000/month.
  • Performance Bonus: $500 per qualified lead beyond the monthly target.
  • Bonus eligibility begins after landing your first 6 qualified leads.
  • Bonuses are paid out 2 months after the lead is landed, contingent on client retention.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1+ year of experience in outbound sales, cold outreach, or lead generation (preferred).
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Confidence in high-volume outreach and objection handling.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and results-oriented.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and LinkedIn prospecting tools.

Why Join ScaleSource

  • Clear, performance-based structure — earn more by exceeding goals.
  • Transparent expectations with quick feedback loops.
  • Supportive, no-fluff team culture.
  • A meaningful mission: helping businesses scale while empowering global talent.

title: Analista de Dados (BI) – Marketing e Produto
description:
Overview

O que é a nstech?

A nstech é a mais completa plataforma open logistics do mundo, construindo o futuro digital do transporte de cargas junto a todo o ecossistema logístico. Nosso objetivo é conectar e transformar a cadeia logística, oferecendo centenas de soluções integradas em um único lugar. Acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para melhorar o mundo, reduzindo a emissão de CO2, acidentes e roubos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Business Intelligence no time de Product Marketing. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade!

Main responsibilities

  • Criar e acompanhar métricas de negócio e de produto, transformando números em informações estratégicas;
  • Realizar segmentações de clientes para apoiar campanhas e estratégias direcionadas;
  • Conduzir estudos de mercado (TAM, SAM, SOM) para embasar decisões de expansão;
  • Organizar e interpretar feedbacks de clientes vindos de diferentes canais (NPS, pesquisas, atendimento, vendas etc.);
  • Elaborar narrativas executivas que traduzam dados em recomendações claras para Product Managers, PMMs e liderança.
  • Analisar a jornada dos usuários no app, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e crescimento;

Requirements and skills

  • Sólida habilidade em análise de dados, métricas e indicadores de negócio;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI) para criação de dashboards e relatórios;
  • Habilidade em storytelling com dados, transformando insights em recomendações claras para Product Managers e liderança;
  • Experiência prévia com HubSpot ou outro CRM;
  • Conhecimento em SQL ou outra linguagem de consulta a banco de dados;
  • Boa capacidade de organização e priorização de informações para diferentes stakehold.

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com estudos de mercado (TAM, SAM, SOM);
  • Conhecimento em segmentação de clientes e análise de comportamento de usuários;
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de análise de dados ou linguagens como Python/R;
  • Vivência em Revenue Operations (RevOps).

Additional information

O que esperamos de você:

Na nstech, temos uma cultura baseada em valores e esperamos que todos os nstechers não apenas se identifiquem, mas também vivam essa cultura em seu dia a dia. Acreditamos que a cultura é uma das maiores vantagens competitivas para negócios bem-sucedidos, pois é algo que não pode ser copiado integralmente.

Nossos pilares culturais e seus atributos são:

  • • Servir: foco no cliente, humildade, transparência e ética
  • • Equipe: valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a vontade de colocar a mão na massa e o espírito colaborativo
  • • Resultados: buscamos agilidade, melhoria contínua, geração de valor a longo prazo e foco nos resultados

Por que trabalhar na nstech?

Temos a visão de ser a plataforma de tecnologia para logística e mobilidade que conecta os elos e gera mais valor para os negócios da rede integrada de logística da América Latina. Atualmente, contamos com uma equipe de mais de 3500 nstechers comprometidos em melhorar o mundo por meio da tecnologia aplicada à logística e mobilidade. Estamos empenhados em gerar impacto para a sociedade, clientes, colaboradores e acionistas, e queremos somar forças com pessoas cheias de energia e propósito para fazer parte de nossa equipe e dessa transformação. Além disso:

  • Você trabalhará com uma equipe que desenvolve a maior plataforma de logística da América Latina.
  • Nosso ambiente de trabalho é altamente colaborativo, e adoramos compartilhar conhecimentos. Aqui, você terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico.
  • Essa oportunidade oferece é remoto, permitindo que você atue de onde quiser.
  • A vaga é para contratação CLT , com todos os benefícios dessa modalidade.
  • Plano de saúde com baixa coparticipação.
  • Convênio odontológico totalmente custeado pela empresa.
  • Seguro de vida para proteção e tranquilidade, também totalmente custeado pela empresa.
  • Você também receberá um benefício flexível para usar em refeições ou alimentação.
  • Para promover um ambiente equilibrado e cuidar do seu bem-estar, incluímos o Gympass e o Zenklub em nossos benefícios, proporcionando acesso a atividades físicas e serviços de bem-estar mental.
  • No dia do seu aniversário, você terá um dia de folga para aproveitar.

Vem fazer parte da equipe NSTech e fazer parte dessa transformação!

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We are looking for an experienced and talented Associate Director of Creative to join our team.
The Associate Director of Creative is a player/coach designer who will work as a manager of a pod of Designers, as well as delivering your own AI-powered Creative Direction, Marketing Design, and UI/UX Design engagements at high bar of client services and visual quality. You bring expertise in integrating AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney into your workflows to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding new ways to use AI to break barriers and being on the cutting edge of this paradigm shift.
In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Creative. You’ll use your strong design background to be an advocate for our design processes and philosophy, and supervise a small cohort of Designers by providing feedback on their work to develop their skillsets across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. Your main focus in the first 60 days will be helping the creative team integrate ChatGPT and AI into their work to discover and implement efficiencies. You’ll bring your expertise in AI workflows to help build processes and trainings with the Director of Creative. You’ll also be responsible for owning Creative Direction engagements that impact paid marketing and organic channels for e-commerce clients.
We’re looking for a candidate with deep experience in using AI to power their work at a commercial level, and who can apply this experience to the direction and development of junior designers. A strong candidate has a best-in-class visual eye, attention-to-detail, and client services acumen.
This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.
Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 1-2 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:
  • Be a champion for AI-powered work, holding trainings on best practices for the team and building efficient workflows for the team in partnership with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead Creative Direction engagements focused on transforming paid or organic marketing channels through deliverables like content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as capacity allows, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites. Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:
  • 3-6+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design, marketing design, and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client-ready assets powered by AI outputs is required.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.
  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
What It's Like To Work At Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

title: Project Assistant, Abrolhos Carbon
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY – This position is based in Brazil (remote), preferably in Espirito Santo or Bahia; candidates must reside in Brazil. The Project Assistant for CI‑Brasil’s Carbono Abrolhos initiative supports the implementation of the project, with a special focus on activities in the states of Bahia and Espírito Santo. Responsibilities include contributing to the technical planning of field and operational activities related to climate finance projects and carbon credit origination.

Responsibilities

Support for the Implementation of Carbon Credit Origination and Climate Finance Projects

  • Support the implementation of carbon credit origination and climate finance projects at CI‑Brasil, contributing to planning, refining deliverables, and improving outcomes linked to the Climate Solutions Directorate. This includes efforts to achieve programmatic and project goals, covering indicators related to financing, people benefited, carbon, and compliance with social and environmental safeguards.
  • Conduct monitoring and evaluation—both in the field and remotely—of the implementation of different phases of carbon credit origination projects and activities carried out by local partners (planning, contracting, engagement, monitoring, and closure), analysis of technical reports, and input into monitoring platforms.
  • Support administrative tasks related to project implementation and stakeholder engagement across different phases of the carbon credit origination process. This includes organizing events, training sessions, producing outreach materials, coordinating technical visits, participating in meetings, and preparing drafts and records.

Project Implementation and Monitoring

  • Support data collection, organization, and systematization related to participating properties (e.g., registration data, available area, land‑use practices, etc.).
  • Assist in consolidating technical information required for project audits and third‑party verifications.
  • Ensure spreadsheets and databases are kept up to date, maintaining consistency and data quality for technical and financial reporting.
  • Support the preparation of materials for technical meetings, field visits, and certification or verification audits.
  • Contribute to field logistics for engagement, monitoring, or auditing activities (e.g., scheduling, transportation, materials, etc.).
  • Assist in tracking work plans and timelines, flagging any delays or deviations to the coordination team, especially those related to monitoring activities.

Communication and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support communication and relationship‑building with rural landowners participating in the project, answering questions and organizing necessary information to ensure engagement.
  • Assist in organizing meetings, trainings, and workshops with landowners and partners, including logistical support and activity documentation.
  • Contribute to the preparation of simplified reports on the progress of activities with producers and local partners.
  • Help systematize stories, best practices, and lessons learned from the project to support communication materials and donor reporting.
  • Engage with local partners and project beneficiaries through meetings, events, and presentations, helping to maintain stakeholder engagement, especially with rural producers. Support project outreach and engagement during meetings and events as determined by project managers.
  • Participate in field activities related to carbon monitoring (e.g., forest inventories, socio‑environmental data collection, and verification of compliance with applicable methodologies).
  • Support the development of specific MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) carbon reports, ensuring quality, clarity, and alignment with internationally recognized standards and methodologies (e.g., GHG Protocol, VCS, CCB).

Working Conditions

  • Flexible, with frequent field presence in projects located in Southern Bahia and Espírito Santo.
  • Involvement in both administrative tasks and field activities.
  • Regular in‑person participation required for meetings, field trips, and other activities, both nationally and internationally, including travel to remote regions within Brazil.
  • Preferably based in the project implementation region – Bahia or Espírito Santo.

Qualifications

Required

  • Up to 2 years of experience in carbon credit origination projects, preferably in forest restoration initiatives.
  • Technical and/or practical knowledge in ecology, conservation, restoration, and carbon projects.
  • Experience with project monitoring and data collection platforms.
  • Ability to support and conduct Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) processes within project contexts.
  • Experience in preparing technical reports and meeting minutes.
  • Strong skills in structuring and facilitating workshops.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt in a fast‑paced work environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the country.
  • Availability for frequent travel.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and intermediate English (with the ability for technical communication) is desirable.
  • Previous experience in the non‑profit/NGO sector is an asset.

Preferred

  • University degree in Environmental Management, Forest Engineering, Biological Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related fields.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Application Deadline : October 20, 2025 (11:49 PM EST)

Está preparado(a) para fazer parte de um time que faz a diferença, buscando oportunidades de desenvolvimento para sempre fazer o melhor? O Grupo Urca Energia é esse lugar.

Nosso grupo, que inclui as empresas Bem Verde , Gás Verde , Eva Energia , Urca Trading e Urca Gás , oferece soluções ambientais incríveis, desde a produção até a venda, para quem acredita em um futuro mais sustentável.

Nosso objetivo é revolucionar o futuro energético do Brasil, e não estamos esperando pelo amanhã para agir. Hoje, com determinação, trabalhamos para promover e impulsionar a transição energética nas empresas , e este é nosso propósito. Somos líderes no setor, com a maior planta de biometano da América Latina , no estado do Rio de Janeiro.

Se você quer contribuir com esse propósito, venha fazer parte do nosso time como Analista de Controle de Documentos para atuar no escritório da Barra.

Main responsibilities

  • Atuar na gestão e aprimoramento do sistema de documentação técnica da engenharia, utilizando a plataforma Green Docs como ferramenta central de controle e versionamento;
  • Garantir que todos os documentos de engenharia, como projetos, especificações, fluxogramas, listas de materiais e relatórios, sejam recebidos, revisados e distribuídos conforme os padrões internos e contratuais;
  • Padronizar nomenclaturas, formatos e metadados, assegurando conformidade com normas corporativas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Acompanhar prazos de emissão e aprovação, atualizando relatórios e indicadores de andamento;
  • Apoiar engenheiros, fornecedores e demais áreas na submissão e atualização correta dos documentos no sistema;
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre áreas internas e externas, garantindo o fluxo eficiente e seguro das informações técnicas;
  • Conduzir auditorias documentais e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de controle e armazenamento;
  • Cuidar da integridade, rastreabilidade e backup de toda a base documental técnica, mantendo conformidade com normas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior completo em Cursos de Engenharias, Administração, Arquivologia, Biblioteconomia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimentoda plataforma Green Docse de seus módulos de versionamento, workflows e distribuição (Desejável);
  • Vivência com outras ferramentas de gestão de documentos técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em estruturar fluxos, mapear riscos, garantir rastreabilidade e promover boas práticas de governança da informação técnica;
  • Excel intermediário;
  • Inglês intermediário (para leitura técnica).

Additional information

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em um cartão único de benefícios;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total Pass.

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We are looking for an experienced and talented Associate Director of Creative to join our team.
The Associate Director of Creative is a player/coach designer who will work as a manager of a pod of Designers, as well as delivering your own AI-powered Creative Direction, Marketing Design, and UI/UX Design engagements at high bar of client services and visual quality. You bring expertise in integrating AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Midjourney into your workflows to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding new ways to use AI to break barriers and being on the cutting edge of this paradigm shift.
In this role, you’ll report to the Director of Creative. You’ll use your strong design background to be an advocate for our design processes and philosophy, and supervise a small cohort of Designers by providing feedback on their work to develop their skillsets across paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. Your main focus in the first 60 days will be helping the creative team integrate ChatGPT and AI into their work to discover and implement efficiencies. You’ll bring your expertise in AI workflows to help build processes and trainings with the Director of Creative. You’ll also be responsible for owning Creative Direction engagements that impact paid marketing and organic channels for e-commerce clients.
We’re looking for a candidate with deep experience in using AI to power their work at a commercial level, and who can apply this experience to the direction and development of junior designers. A strong candidate has a best-in-class visual eye, attention-to-detail, and client services acumen.
This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.
Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 1-2 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:
  • Be a champion for AI-powered work, holding trainings on best practices for the team and building efficient workflows for the team in partnership with the Director of Creative.
  • Lead Creative Direction engagements focused on transforming paid or organic marketing channels through deliverables like content calendars, creative briefs, and strategic proposals.
  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as capacity allows, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites. Emphasize branded UI, conversion-focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design and creative direction work to clients, explaining choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:
  • 3-6+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in creative direction, marketing design, or responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design, marketing design, and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience working with AI tools and producing client-ready assets powered by AI outputs is required.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand-off.
  • Comfortable with client-facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
What It's Like To Work At Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

description:
Overview

Analista de Compliance - Simpaul Brazil role at Binance. Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem with a broad portfolio of digital-asset products and services. Simpaul is a Binance Company following its M&A approval by the Brazilian Central Bank in December 2024. This is a 100% remote, work-from-home position with no visa sponsorship.

We are seeking a Mid-Level Compliance Analyst who will support the Coordination of the department in executing activities to ensure the company operates in accordance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and market best practices. The role focuses on Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Combating the Financing of Terrorism and Proliferation of Weapons of Mass Destruction (CFT/AML), and Anti-Fraud efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Administration, Economics, Accounting, or related areas
  • Experience: Previous experience in financial institutions or payment companies, preferably regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN)
  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Proficiency in Excel; strong critical thinking, communication, and objective writing for internal records and report preparation

Compliance, AML/CFT and Anti-Fraud Responsibilities

  • AML/CFT: Support the implementation and review of policies, procedures, and controls related to AML/CFT
  • Assist with KYC (Know Your Customer), KYP (Know Your Provider), and KYE (Know Your Employee) procedures
  • Monitor financial transactions to identify suspicious AML/CFT operations
  • Conduct analyses of alerts generated by transactional monitoring systems
  • Support the preparation of data reports related to AML/CFT topics
  • Prepare and report mandatory communications to the Financial Intelligence Unit (COAF) or regulatory authorities, when applicable
  • Anti-Fraud: Support the implementation and review of policies, procedures, and controls related to anti-fraud
  • Analyze transactions and behaviors to detect indications of fraud in real time or post-event
  • Investigate fraud cases reported by clients or identified by internal systems
  • Maintain and improve risk indicators and prevention mechanisms
  • Assist in developing anti-fraud rules and parameters in monitoring systems
  • Participate in testing new anti-fraud controls and suggest improvements in existing processes
  • Produce management reports on fraud occurrences and trends to support decision-making
  • Analyze and respond to cases involving the Special Refund Mechanism (MED)

Why Binance

  • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
  • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
  • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
  • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
  • Competitive salary and company benefits
  • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Executivo de vendas senior farmer enterprise
description:
Visão geral

Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes. Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo. Estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, economizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o elo que ajuda a construir um futuro mais simples para as empresas brasileiras.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão: mapear as necessidades do cliente para oferecer soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da empresa, buscando oportunidades em novas áreas e aumentando a presença em grupos econômicos.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos: atuar diretamente nas negociações de expansão de contratos.
  • Parceria interna: colaborar com equipes de Customer Success, Produto e Marketing para entregar valor contínuo e alinhar estratégias.
  • Análise de dados e métricas: monitorar o desempenho das contas, como Net Revenue Retention (NRR), churn e expansão, para orientar ações estratégicas.
  • Gestão de pipeline: manter um pipeline atualizado com foco em oportunidades de expansão.
  • Acompanhar portfólio de clientes: desenvolver e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com decisores e influenciadores das contas existentes.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em vendas, em posições de Account Executive, Farmer ou similar, preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia B2B.
  • Experiência com negociações complexas com grandes contas, gestão e crescimento de contas Enterprise ou KA.
  • Habilidade em negociação: expertise em lidar com contratos complexos e longos ciclos de vendas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de vendas: familiaridade com técnicas como SPIN Selling, Challenger Sales, ou similares.
  • Orientação por dados: capacidade de analisar métricas como NET New, ARPA, LTV e churn para embasar decisões.
  • Habilidades excepcionais de comunicação, organização, escuta ativa, construção de relacionamentos e resolução de problemas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade ou coparticipação para nossos Qivers e seus filhos.
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos em folha e possibilidade de inclusão de filhos, parentes, pais e sogros.
  • Benefício Flash Flex com um valor bem competitivo, aceito em restaurantes, supermercados, padarias, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento, sem nenhum desconto.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados da empresa (PPR) competitivo com o mercado.
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos.
  • Ajuda de custo nos 03 primeiros meses após o nascimento ou adoção no valor de R$ 1.000,00.
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 06 anos de idade.
  • Total Pass; Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios; Seguro de vida.

Mais informações

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país; enviamos equipamentos para montar o seu escritório ou você pode trabalhar na sede com estacionamento gratuito.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado e desenvolvimento constante, com incentivo ao crescimento individual, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe.
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar com aulas online gratuitas de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral.
  • Parcerias de apoio à saúde mental e desenvolvimento, incluindo recursos como Ana Health, Vamos Escrever e Cambly.

Diversidade e Privacidade

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive. Garantimos liberdade e respeito para falar e ouvir, visando experiências positivas de todos os colaboradores. Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais: coletamos e tratamos dados fornecidos no formulário de candidatura e no currículo anexado, para identificação, comunicação e análise das candidaturas. A gestão de vagas é realizada pelo sistema InHire, e orientamos a leitura dos termos e políticas de cada plataforma utilizada. Em dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato pelos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Em caso de dúvidas sobre dados pessoais, entre em contato através dos meios informados em nossa Política de Privacidade.

Nosso Ambiente De Trabalho

  • Trabalho em equipe: ninguém cresce sozinho.

title: Talent Sourcer
description:
The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

As a Talent Sourcer , you play a key role in driving high-quality talent pipelines across Valtech’s most business-critical roles. You bring sourcing expertise, strategic thinking, and a consultative mindset to engage, assess, and nurture top talent aligned to our hiring needs.

You work in close collaboration with Talent Partners, delivery leads, and hiring managers to understand hiring challenges, shape sourcing strategies, and deliver measurable impact. As an experienced sourcing professional, you balance execution with advisory—leveraging market insights, data, and creative sourcing methods to solve hiring problems and improve outcomes.

This role is ideal for a curious, data-literate talent acquisition professional looking to deepen their sourcing influence while operating in a fast-paced, global digital consultancy environment.

Role responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and expand a database of prospects that meet the company’s current and future business hiring needs
  • Maintain a high-level understanding of Valtech’s value proposition, key differentiators, company goals, technologies, and client success stories
  • Create a partnership with the Recruiters and hiring stakeholders to become a trusted source for quality candidates
  • Build and maintain strategic talent pipelines across priority disciplines and geographies, aligned to workforce plans and future hiring needs
  • Take ownership of candidate outreach and engagement using inclusive, personalized messaging that strengthens Valtech’s employer brand
  • Build talent pipelines and engage with exceptional talent to join Valtech for our Technology, Delivery, and Creative practices
  • Create and own the best practices around sourcing talented individuals
  • Provide timely updates and collaborate effectively within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring high-quality data and candidate experience

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition
  • Proficient English and Portuguese communication skills
  • Advanced Boolean searching skills, and effectively engage with people
  • Drive to succeed and grow
  • Prominent organization, communication, and time management skills
  • Detail oriented and analytical
  • A desire to work in a fast-paced, self-directed entrepreneurial environment
  • Ability to work autonomously, adapting quickly to evolving priorities and stakeholder needs
  • Experience with LinkedIn Recruiter

Nice to have qualifications

  • A 4-year degree is desired
  • A strong understanding of enterprise IT concepts and emerging technology is desired, but not required
  • Experience with an ATS (we use Greenhouse)
  • Working for IT Consulting company / related industry experience

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a full-time, remote position based in Brazil .

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.

???? Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

title: Pessoa Product Manager Sênior

A Knewin é líder em inteligência de dados na América Latina. Nossa missão é ajudar as maiores marcas do mercado a navegar na complexidade do cenário de informação, conectando-as com seus públicos para construir e proteger sua reputação. Para fazer isso, estamos a construir uma cultura de produto moderna, onde equipes empoderadas (compostas por Produto, Design e Engenharia) têm autonomia para resolver problemas reais de clientes. Somos guiados por dados, obcecados por resultados de negócio e acreditamos na colaboração para execução de planos efetivos e metas arrojadas para chegar às melhores soluções.

Nossa time é formado por pessoas curiosas e proativas. Este é um momento de transformação único na Knewin. Após um período de crescimento e aquisições, estamos agora focados em unificar nossas plataformas, modernizar nossa tecnologia e elevar a experiência do nosso cliente a um novo patamar. Se você quer ter um impacto massivo, construir algo duradouro e ajudar a definir o futuro de uma empresa líder de mercado, a sua hora é agora.

Sua Missão

Sua missão será liderar a estratégia do produto que é o coração da nossa missão de "conectar marcas com seus públicos", criando uma plataforma de dois lados que entrega valor tanto para as marcas que contam suas histórias, quanto para os jornalistas que as descobrem.

  • Liderar a estratégia para a criação de uma plataforma de dois lados, definindo a proposta de valor e a experiência tanto para as marcas (nossos clientes) quanto para os jornalistas (nossa audiência), criando um poderoso efeito de rede;
  • Identificar e validar novas oportunidades de crescimento e monetização , explorando novos casos de uso e modelos de negócio que aumentem o valor do produto para nossos clientes e a receita;
  • Ser a voz do cliente dentro da empresa, traduzindo necessidades complexas em uma estratégia e um roadmap de produto claro e focado em resultados;
  • Colaborar com a tríade (Produto, Design e Engenharia) para definir as melhores soluções de investimento na nossa plataforma técnica, equilibrando a necessidade de inovação com a garantia de performance, estabilidade e escalabilidade para nossos maiores clientes.
  • Ensino superior em áreas relacionadas a Tecnologia, Comunicação ou experiência prática equivalente;
  • Vivência como Product Manager, de preferência em produtos SaaS B2B;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de um produto em todo o seu ciclo de vida, desde a descoberta e estratégia até o lançamento e iteração contínua;
  • Capacidade de comunicar problemas de cliente e requisitos de negócio de forma clara e concisa para a equipe de desenvolvimento
  • Entendimento de como colaborar eficazmente com equipes de engenharia em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil para entregar valor de forma contínua e interativa.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com produtos de marketplace, plataformas de dois lados (two-sided platforms) ou produtos com efeito de rede.

Fazer um mundo melhor em parceria com empresas responsáveis e comprometidas com os seus públicos.

Somos a Knowin , a maior plataforma em gestão de reputação com inteligência de dados com mais de 2000 clientes.

Ajudamos empresas e marcas com gestão de reputação e exposição por meio de soluções de inteligência de dados para promover conexões com seus públicos com o objetivo de ganhar a preferência deles, assim possibilitando resultados de negócio superiores.

Para cumprir nosso propósito, desenvolvemos três verticais de soluções :

• Gestão de reputação proativa e acionável (Knewin Reputation)

• Monitoramento de imagem de marca (Knewin Monitoring e Monitoramento de Notícias)
